purpose: One frozen finite geometric information-value model; not a simulator, Q evaluator, or autonomous benchmark

geometric_observation.signature: Sorted visible physical point coordinates and outward normals only; no role, face id, class, area, or denominator
geometric_observation.finite_model_limit: Visible vertical-face quadrature points, not depth pixels; exact only within this declared finite position and observation model

reward.name: equal_station_macro_fraction_of_potentially_observed_reference_vertical_exterior_area
reward.area_weighting: Geometric rectangle quadrature area only; equal station weights 1/2; no class reward weight
reward.normalization: Each true station vertical exterior reference area, evaluator-side only; union-interior contacts excluded
reward.repeat_observation: Set union, zero additional reward for duplicates

solver.method: Exact finite-horizon belief-state dynamic programming over all legal actions with exact return-heading feasibility
